newsitem.title: CHILE: Banco de Credito seeks loan backers.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Credito seeks loan backers.

text.p: Chile's Banco de Credito e Inversiones (BCI) will begin a road show in New York this week to find backers for a $100 million syndicated loan led by Chase Securities Inc, said BCI.
The road show, in which BCI executives will present the bank's history and current local position, will last about three days in New York before moving to London, a bank spokesman said.
The syndicated loan has a five-year duration and will be repaid in one block at its due date, said a BCI statement.
The bank will use the money for medium-term credits to business clients, it said, adding that general manager Lionel Olavarria and international manager Ricardo Gabler will lead the presentation.

BCI was the sixth largest bank operating in Chile in terms of outstanding loan portfolio in the first seven months of this year but third in terms of profits at 13.06 billion pesos to end-July, official figures showed.
